item.title: [AI & I by Every] The SaaS Apocalypse Is a Goldmine With Figma’s Matt Colyer
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:27 The SaaS apocalypse or the next era of software, if you will. I'm really excited about it, and I think Figma and a lot of other SaaS businesses are too. Because, like, I've worked in developer tools for a long time, and maybe five, ten years ago, the estimate of, like, number of developers worldwide was, like, 25,000,000, 30,000,000, 40,000,000, give or take.
